svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four posts: two front (3,160 long) and two back (3,000 long), each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set 600 into the ground; the tops are cut at 5 deg so the roof

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: falls to the back. Back posts stand 2,400 above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Layout: 1,300 between post centres across, 1,800 front to back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: two 13 mm holes across each post top, 60 down, for the beam

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cleats; 9 mm holes for the box, siren and sign brackets on site.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the buried 700 mm with bitumen; cap the tops.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Collars: auger 300 mm holes 650 deep; 50 mm of gravel; stand the post

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plumb on it and pour concrete to ground level, sloped to shed water.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: posts plumb within 5 mm over 2 m; diagonals equal within 10.
